decision_rule.diagnostic_medians: NDVI, NDWI, and albedo final medians must each be strictly closer to the frozen development-valid median than to the frozen legacy double-offset median.
decision_rule.normalized_difference_ranges: NDVI and NDWI fractions outside [-1, 1] must each be strictly closer to the development-valid control fraction.
decision_rule.paired_albedo_shift: On all common acquisition-date/tract pairs, median absolute error to the +0.1 corrected-shift hypothesis must be lower than error to the 0.0 repeated-offset hypothesis.
